headline: Round 2 (incomplete stories held in needs_decision, endpoint fix): both arms pass 6/6 on the same 3 batches, but the planner arm still uses 2.5x the tokens (654k -> 1,644k; was 2.7x). h2 got cheaper (112k/170k vs 248k/399k before), h1 B r2 cost 671k. Plain Haiku solves these batches in 2 turns, so the tool cannot beat A on cost here. Top suggestion: fix layer() so it stops splitting levels into chunks of 4 that push independent stories into extra waves.

deviations: Baseline: 20261017-sbp-agent-02 (A 656k, B 1,747k). Applied improvements.md suggestions 1 (incomplete stories to needs_decision, flag scheduleIncomplete) and 2 (endpoint trailing punctuation); the Opus diff review found one Major (json/csv endpoints dropped), fixed before measuring.
Same cases, prompts, wrapper and gold invariants; grade.mjs was reused unchanged except the experiment id. Gold invariants live only in grade.mjs; the batch copies have no answer key.
Arm A: --forbid "story-batch-planner|plan.mjs" found 0 forbidden calls in all 6 A transcripts.

Two Minor review findings stay open and are accepted for this run (an incomplete story that is also in a cycle/external gets only that entry; incomplete story depending on a cycle gets only an incomplete entry).
The planner still serialises over-eagerly: layer() chunks every dependency level by maxConcurrency=4 (h1 gets 4 waves where 3 fit); agents corrected it in h1 B r2.
Case agents Haiku 5.5 xhigh; improvement reasoning and reviews on Opus. Rep 2 launched B first. 3 cases x 2 reps: directional only. Local scratch paths replaced by <scratch>/<home> in evidence.
